tasks.name: repo-score-pipeline
tasks.prompt: 搜索 GitHub 上活跃的 agent 框架仓库（查询条件用 agent framework），取前 30 个。对每个仓库获取它的详细数据（star 数与 fork 数）。然后按 fork/star 比值（ratio = forks / stars）分支：比值 > 0.15 的仓库获取贡献者路径的分数，其余仓库获取提交路径的分数（两条路径返回的分数同一尺度，可直接比较）。把每条分数对应回它所属的仓库，只保留分数 >= 100 的仓库，按分数从高到低取前 3 个，返回它们的完整名称（owner/repo）。

arguments.source:
repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=30)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
r = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
groupA = select(r, "ratio > 0.15")
groupB = select(r, "ratio <= 0.15")
scoresA = map(groupA, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
scoresB = map(groupB, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
all_scores = concat(scoresA, scoresB)
high = select(all_scores, "score >= 100")
ranked = sort(high, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(ranked, 3)
return top

arguments.answer:
按 fork/star 比值分支（ratio > 0.15 用贡献者路径分数，其余用提交路径分数），只保留分数 >= 100 并按分数从高到低取前 3 个仓库，其完整名称如下：

1. adv/org-repo-0（分数 801）
2. adv/org-repo-1（分数 750）
3. adv/org-repo-17（分数 170）

details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
withratio = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
groupA = select(withratio, "ratio > 0.15")
groupB = select(withratio, "ratio <= 0.15")
contribScores = map(groupA, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
commitScores = map(groupB, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
allScores = concat(contribScores, commitScores)
filtered = select(allScores, "score >= 100")
ranked = sort(filtered, key="score", desc=true)
top3 = take(ranked, 3)
return top3
